_meta.description: Default carrier-status -> canonical Base Shop HQ status mapping. Keys are raw values from carrier statements (case-insensitive, whitespace-trimmed); values are one of the canonical policies.status enum: Draft, Submitted, Pending, Issued, Issue Paid, Terminated, Potential Lapse. Per-carrier overrides live in carrier_profiles.status_value_map.
notes: Issued = carrier approved the policy; agent has not been paid yet.
Issue Paid = agent has been paid the commission for this policy.
Inforce / In Force / Active are legacy or carrier-state values; treat as Issued (approved-but-payment-status-unknown) until a paid commission row promotes the policy to Issue Paid.
